The '''Alliance''' was a model of personal [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Kurtob]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
